column1: # decisions-status.tsv -- sidecar status table for the ruling ledger (Track R-D,
# Clear the Stage, 2026-08-06; plan of record review/stage-clear/refactor-plan.md §R-D).
# One row per ruling R39-R120, across all volumes (tier0 DECISIONS volumes + klee-mod).
#   Every row has now been READ. The Class-P status pass of 2026-08-06
#   handle: docs/registry/p-ledger.md) triaged the 77 rows that used to say
#   UNREVIEWED, under the order's own decision rule:
#     - OPERATIVE means NO CITABLE SUPERSEDER WAS FOUND. It is an absence
#       claim with its search scope recorded in the evidence column, not a
#       judgment that the ruling is wise, current in spirit, or beyond
#       re-opening. Anyone holding a citation this pass missed should file it.
#     - AMENDED-BY / SUPERSEDED-BY / DISCHARGED-BY:R<n> is recorded ONLY on an
#       explicit citation -- a later ruling or a dated in-entry banner naming
#       the R-number in strike/amend/discharge/override language -- quoted in
#       the evidence column, with the scope of the move stated. Where the move
#       is partial, the evidence says so and the rest of the ruling is
#     - DOUBT means supersession is ARGUABLE and this pass refuses to guess:
#       a partial amendment, or a scope a later ruling narrowed without naming
#       the ruling. Doubt disqualifies (Class-P charter §2). The DOUBT rows
#       are a single [USER] queue row riding the S4-G9 sitting.
#   The interpretive line this pass drew, recorded so it can be overruled in
#   one place: a LATER BALANCE DOSE ON THE SAME CARD OR KNOB IS NOT A
#   SUPERSEDER of the ruling that shipped the earlier number. Each dose is a
#   number in a declared sequence, taken in its own stamped world, and every
#   such ruling stands as the record of what it shipped. Only a ruling that
#   names another ruling moves that ruling's status here.
# The digest generator (tools/gen_decisions_digest.py) is a pure reader of this
# file; it renders each row's status and never authors one.
